text:
alex g: HelioMatrix just confirmed hardware shipment for our mini run. NDA is countersigned (they sent the PDF). Can we align on 1) bench plan, 2) telemetry schema, 3) handover window? I can do an initial run next Wednesday.

samir p: Awesome. I can own the benchmark side. Need target SLOs and perf counters from them. @maria ops can you coordinate lab access? :white_check_mark:

maria ops: Yep — lab slot tentative Thu-Fri next week. Need to confirm power and rack specs from HelioMatrix. I emailed them the templated checklist.

devin r: For telemetry, we should reuse the prior silicon schema but add per-device temperature and VRM stats. Suggest sample keys: device_id, fw_rev, temp_c, pwr_w, fan_rpm. Also include a short heartbeat every 30s.

bench-bot: Suggested benchmark command:
```
./run_bench --model=resnet50 --sequence=128 --it=100 --traces=on --telemetry=tele_schema_v3.json
```
Attach telemetry as gzip and upload to: s3://redwood-eval/helio/2765432100/

alex g: Good. HelioMatrix asked for a short report template (one-pager + perf CSV). @laura pm can you draft the template? Also legal wants raw counters redacted from any public materials.

laura pm: Will do the one-pager draft by EOD tomorrow. For public messaging we suggest a joint "tech preview" blurb with an embargo date; legal wants a 14-day review window after our draft.

samir p: For the bench plan: propose microbench + end-to-end inference + a stress run. Microbenchers: latency p50/p95/p99, throughput, mem usage, temp under sustained load. Stress run should be 6 hours continuous at target throughput.

maria ops: Noted. I'll map power and rack requests and confirm exact dates with HelioMatrix. Also we need SSH creds and routing for the telemetry collector — prefer a jumpbox in prod-vpc.

devin r: One more ask: firmware image version must be in telemetry, and include sample dmesg output in the one-pager appendix if possible.

alex g: Thanks all. Action items: samir draft bench steps + CSV schema; laura draft pub template; maria confirm lab and creds; devin finalize telemetry schema. I'll ping HelioMatrix to confirm Thu/Fri window and share NDA redaction notes. :rocket:

bench-bot: Created run ticket #HM-1034 and upload folder s3://redwood-eval/helio/2765432100/

laura pm: Shared initial one-pager in thread (link) — feedback welcome.

samir p: Quick Q — do we require quantized model variants this run or keep FP16 only? Prefer to include int8 sweep if hardware supports it.

alex g: HelioMatrix said early firmware supports int8 but with caveats. Let's include a fast int8 sweep (5 runs) but main baseline remains FP16.

maria ops: Confirmed rack power OK. HelioMatrix will ship 2 units and a 1U collector. I'll send handoff doc shortly.

devin r: I'll post the telemetry schema JSON in the docs repo and link it here.

alex g: Perfect. We'll regroup post-run for feedback loop with HelioMatrix. Thanks everyone. :clap:
